riley: PR opened to tidy Optimize examples: fix batch/cache/quant snippets, add migration notes for v0.8. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4922
jamal: Thanks. Any breaking snippets?
riley: Two: old `batch_size` -> new `batch_config`, and streaming API rename. I updated examples and added a tiny migration helper.
tess: Can you drop the helper into migration.md as an optional snippet (not mainline)?
riley: Done. snippet: ```python
# migrate batch_size -> batch_config
def to_batch_config(params):
    return {"max_batch_tokens": params.pop('batch_size', 64)*8}
```
jamal: Staging smoke: kv-prefetch example failed due to tokenizer differences; left comment with expected output tweak.
docs-bot: CI: mkdocs lint flagged table width in quant rationale.
riley: Fixed table and force-pushed. Also added short bench micro-snippet showing q8 vs q4 latency.
tess: Assigning reviewers: @jamal (qa), @tess (docs). Please leave quick thumbs.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-4922--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration.html (staging)
jamal: LGTM pending the expected-output tweak.
riley: Updated expected output; merging after CI green. Thanks!
